etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Late Middle English fabulous, fabulose, from Latin fābulōsus (“celebrated in fable”); Equivalent to fable +‎ -ous.

definitions.definition: Of or relating to fable, myth or legend.
Characteristic of fables; marvelous, extraordinary, incredible.

quote.citation: 1949, Joseph Campbell, “The Hero and the God”, in The Hero with a Thousand Faces:
quote.text: [F]abulous forces are there encountered and a decisive victory is won:  […]

definitions.definition: Fictional or not believable; made up.
(obsolete) Known for telling fables or falsehoods; unreliable.
